LanguageData.MDG_DeckStowed: {0}: there is no level above this landing site for the upper deck, so it was folded away ({1} objects). Pawns from it were set down on the main deck. It will unfold the next time the ship lands somewhere with levels above.
LanguageData.MDG_DeckDeployed: {0}: the folded upper deck unfolded again ({1} objects).
LanguageData.MDG_UpperBlockedTerrain: The upper deck (level +{0}) would hit {1} on the level above.
LanguageData.MDG_UpperOutOfBounds: The upper deck (level +{0}) would stick out of the level above.
LanguageData.MDG_OrbitDecks: Ship roofs carry a deck in orbit
LanguageData.MDG_OrbitDecksDesc: As above, So below II normally stops roofs over gravship substructure in orbit from making a rooftop on the level above. Turn this on so gravship decks also work in orbit. Existing orbital maps get their ship rooftops back the next time they load.
LanguageData.MDG_HomeOnDecks: Upper decks join the home area
LanguageData.MDG_HomeOnDecksDesc: When a ship lands, and when a map with a parked ship loads, every upper deck cell above a home-area cell of the main deck is added to the home area. Colonists restricted to Home then also fetch food and work upstairs. Cells are only ever added, never removed.
LanguageData.MDG_VerboseDesc: Writes launch and landing details (upper deck cells, stowing, stair links) to the log. Turn this on when reporting a problem.
